# Kept

> Kept is quote, job and invoice software for Australian service and trade businesses: quotes, jobs, scheduling, invoicing, payments and basic tax, in one app. It is built in depth for lawn care, cleaning, pressure washing and handyman work, with 24 other trades selectable. Australian GST/BAS and mileage tools are built in. Kept is made in Brisbane by a working lawn care operator.

Every business starts on a permanent Free plan (1 person, no card required, capped at 15 clients and 15 jobs/quotes a month). Paid plans are billed monthly and priced by team size, not per seat: Solo $35/mo (1 person), Crew $69/mo (2-4 people), Team $119/mo (5-10 people), Operation from $229/mo (11+ people, priced individually, adds multi-task projects). All prices in AUD, with no GST charged. Recurring jobs repeat weekly, fortnightly or every 4 weeks. Route optimisation, the best driving order for a day's stops opened in Google Maps, is on every plan.

Storage modes: each business chooses how its data is stored (Settings > Account & sync). In Secure mode, the jobs, clients and invoices a business enters are encrypted on its own device before they reach Kept's servers, using a key derived from its own login password, so Kept cannot read them. In Standard mode (the default) that data is stored in ordinary, readable form, which is simpler and has nothing to lose if a password is forgotten. Either way Kept can see a business's name, its login email and which parts of the app are used. Details: https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/privacy

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/): overview, pricing, feature list, comparison against Yardbook, ZenMaid, ServiceM8, SortScape, Fergus, Jobber, Tradify and Simpro.
- [Pricing](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/#pricing): the five tiers in detail.
- [FAQ](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/#faq): trades covered, data privacy, client migration, cost.
- [App](https://app.keptsoftware.com.au/): the product itself - sign-up starts here.

## By trade

- [Lawn care and garden maintenance](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/lawn-care): recurring lawn mowing rounds, rain-day moves, suggested catch-up days after rain, warm and cold season intervals, a turf/reno soil calculator.
- [Cleaning](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/clean): regular and bond (end of lease) clean pricing by rooms and surfaces, staff logins from the Crew plan, before and after photos.
- [Pressure washing](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/wash): house and surface wash pricing by the square metre, gutters by the linear metre, weather blockout.
- [Handyman](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/handyman): job-linked documents, subcontractor work orders, materials tracking, multi-day jobs.

## Free tools

- [Free tools](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/free): a GST calculator, a cents-per-kilometre calculator, BAS due dates, an hourly rate calculator, a printable quote template and a printable weekly truck checklist. They run in the browser: what you type is not sent or saved.

## For customers of a business that uses Kept

- [Request a quote](https://www.keptsoftware.com.au/request-a-quote): for homeowners who want work done, not for signing up to Kept itself.
